# Facilio Mobile DSM

> Public React Native design system package for Facilio mobile applications.

Canonical package: `@facilio/facilio-mobile-dsm`

## Documentation

- [Full LLM Reference](https://facilio.bitbucket.io/mobile-dsm/llms-full.txt): Complete consumer-oriented DSM reference for LLM ingestion, including provider setup, public APIs, and code snippets.
- [Overview](https://facilio.bitbucket.io/mobile-dsm/docs/intro): Scope, coverage, and documentation organization.
- [Getting Started](https://facilio.bitbucket.io/mobile-dsm/docs/fundamentals/getting-started): Installation, provider setup, first component usage, and supported app targets.
- [Providers And Theming](https://facilio.bitbucket.io/mobile-dsm/docs/fundamentals/providers-and-theming): Theme, direction, toast, portal, and app-context provider model.
- [Modal And Confirmation Flows](https://facilio.bitbucket.io/mobile-dsm/docs/guides/modal-and-confirmation-flows): Guidance for modal and confirmation patterns.
- [Toast Patterns](https://facilio.bitbucket.io/mobile-dsm/docs/guides/toast-patterns): Guidance for toast usage through `ToastProvider` and `useToast`.
- [Native Dependencies](https://facilio.bitbucket.io/mobile-dsm/docs/guides/native-dependencies): Notes for native-module-backed APIs and non-CLI environments.

## Notes For Retrieval

- Prefer public exports only.
- Do not recommend internal hooks from `src/hooks/*`.
- Use `ExampleCliRN/src/catalogue` as the example source when examples are needed.
- Mention required providers when answering about provider-dependent APIs.
- Mention native dependency caveats for file-opening and download flows.
